Calendar

The Calendar is the standalone month view that powers the pickers. Style it with .zak-calendar classes and drive it with a few lines of plain JavaScript.

Selectable Calendar

Click a day to mark it zak-selected. The current day carries zak-today and adjacent-month days get zak-outside.

HTML
<div class="zak-calendar" id="calendar"></div>

<script>
    var view = new Date();           // month being shown
    var selected = null;

    function draw() {
        var cal = document.getElementById('calendar');
        var y = view.getFullYear(), m = view.getMonth();
        cal.innerHTML =
            '<div class="zak-calendar-header">' +
                '<button class="zak-calendar-nav-btn" id="prev">&lt;</button>' +
                '<span class="zak-calendar-title">' + view.toLocaleString('en', { month: 'long', year: 'numeric' }) + '</span>' +
                '<button class="zak-calendar-nav-btn" id="next">&gt;</button>' +
            '</div>' +
            '<div class="zak-calendar-grid">' +
                ['Su','Mo','Tu','We','Th','Fr','Sa'].map(function (d) {
                    return '<span class="zak-calendar-weekday">' + d + '</span>';
                }).join('') +
                buildDays() +
            '</div>';
        document.getElementById('prev').onclick = function () { view.setMonth(view.getMonth() - 1); draw(); };
        document.getElementById('next').onclick = function () { view.setMonth(view.getMonth() + 1); draw(); };
    }

    function buildDays() {
        var y = view.getFullYear(), m = view.getMonth();
        var first = new Date(y, m, 1);
        var cells = '';
        for (var i = first.getDay(); i > 0; i--) {
            var d = new Date(y, m, -i + 1);
            cells += dayCell(d, true);
        }
        while (first.getMonth() === m) {
            cells += dayCell(first, false);
            first = new Date(y, m, first.getDate() + 1);
        }
        return cells;
    }

    function dayCell(date, outside) {
        var cls = 'zak-calendar-day' + (outside ? ' zak-outside' : '');
        if (!outside && sameDay(date, new Date())) cls += ' zak-today';
        if (selected && sameDay(date, selected)) cls += ' zak-selected';
        return '<button class="' + cls + '" data-date="' + date.toISOString() + '">' + date.getDate() + '</button>';
    }

    function sameDay(a, b) {
        return a.toDateString() === b.toDateString();
    }

    document.getElementById('calendar').addEventListener('click', function (e) {
        if (!e.target.classList.contains('zak-calendar-day')) return;
        selected = new Date(e.target.getAttribute('data-date'));
        draw();
    });

    draw();
</script>

Range Selection

Pick a start then an end day. Days in between get zak-in-range, and the endpoints get zak-range-start / zak-range-end.

Select a start and end date.

HTML
<div class="zak-calendar" id="range"></div>

<script>
    var start = null, willDraw;
    // Reuse the draw/buildDays helpers above and add:
    function buildDays() {
        // ...same grid build, then classify:
        if (start && end) {
            if (d > start && d < end) cls += ' zak-in-range';
            if (sameDay(d, start)) cls += ' zak-range-start';
            if (sameDay(d, end))   cls += ' zak-range-end';
        }
    }
    // Click handler:
    if (!start) { start = clicked; end = null; }
    else {
        if (clicked < start) { end = start; start = clicked; }
        else { end = clicked; }
    }
    draw();
</script>

Disabled Days

Disable unselectable days with the native disabled attribute; the styles dim them and drop the hover feedback.

HTML
<button class="zak-calendar-day" disabled>5</button>
<button class="zak-calendar-day" disabled>6</button>
<!-- weekends, past days, booked slots, etc. -->

Footer Actions

Pair the grid with zak-calendar-footer for confirm / clear actions, as the pickers do.

September 2026
SuMoTuWeThFrSa 31123456 78910111213 14151617181920 21222324252627 2829301234
HTML
<div class="zak-calendar">
    <div class="zak-calendar-header"><!-- nav --></div>
    <div class="zak-calendar-grid"><!-- days --></div>
    <div class="zak-calendar-footer">
        <button class="zak-btn zak-btn-sm">Clear</button>
        <button class="zak-btn zak-btn-primary zak-btn-sm">Apply</button>
    </div>
</div>

CSS Classes

HTML
.zak-calendar            /* Card wrapping the month grid */
.zak-calendar-header     /* Nav row: title + prev/next */
.zak-calendar-title      /* "September 2026" label */
.zak-calendar-nav        /* Nav button group */
.zak-calendar-nav-btn    /* Prev / next chevron buttons */
.zak-calendar-grid       /* 7-column day grid */
.zak-calendar-weekday    /* Su..Sa column headers */
.zak-calendar-day        /* Day cell (rendered as button) */
.zak-calendar-day.zak-outside   /* Days from adjacent months */
.zak-calendar-day.zak-today     /* Current day */
.zak-calendar-day.zak-selected  /* Single selected day */
.zak-calendar-day.zak-in-range  /* Days inside a range */
.zak-calendar-day:disabled      /* Unselectable days */
.zak-calendar-footer     /* Action row (Clear / Apply) */

JavaScript

HTML
// The calendar is presentational — no JS module ships with it.
// Drive it with plain code: build the grid, read clicks, re-render.

function formatDay(date) {              // "2026-09-08"
    var y = date.getFullYear();
    var m = ('0' + (date.getMonth() + 1)).slice(-2);
    var d = ('0' + date.getDate()).slice(-2);
    return y + '-' + m + '-' + d;
}

grid.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
    if (!e.target.classList.contains('zak-calendar-day')) return;
    var date = new Date(e.target.getAttribute('data-date'));
    // ...store selection and redraw
});

// Keyboard note: within the grid listen for Enter/Space on buttons,
// then mirror the click behavior so selection works without a mouse.

Accessibility

  • Use real <button> elements for days so focus and Enter/Space activation work naturally.
  • Announce state changes with aria-pressed on selected days or an aria-live summary line.
  • Keep the title meaningful (month + year) and label disabled days — visually dimming alone is not enough.
  • For arrow-key navigation, implement roving tabindex over the day cells.
